user.title: Atlantic heat-pump controller
user.description: Select the Atlantic climate controlled by this integration and the room climates representing the valves. The Atlantic climate must provide its current temperature.

data_description.deadband: Temperature gaps up to this value produce no offset. Above it, the largest room deficit raises the target; if all heating rooms are above their setpoints, the largest overshoot lowers it. Default: 0.2 °C.
data_description.delta_max: Maximum absolute offset from the Atlantic climate's current temperature, both upward and downward. Default: 6 °C.

error.no_rooms: Select at least one room climate.
error.target_is_room: The Atlantic climate cannot also be selected as a room climate.
